title: Coin-operated turnstile
goal: Show the complete two-state turnstile machine with labelled coin and push transitions.

rubric.must: Exactly two operational states, Locked and Unlocked, are visibly shown.
A transition labelled coin visibly goes from Locked to Unlocked.
A transition labelled push visibly goes from Unlocked to Locked.
Locked has a visible push self-transition and Unlocked has a visible coin self-transition.
The initial marker visibly enters Locked.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the state exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly shows exactly the two operational states, Locked and Unlocked, with traceable and correctly labelled transitions. The initial marker enters Locked; no blocking defects are visible.

items.evidence: Locked and Unlocked are the only operational states shown.
A horizontal transition labelled “coin” points from Locked to Unlocked.
The lower return transition labelled “push” runs from Unlocked back to Locked.
Locked has a visible self-transition labelled “push”; Unlocked has one labelled “coin”.
The filled initial marker above Locked connects downward into Locked.
